verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at obsessiondb.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a product summary) and a markdown docs root at /docs.md. Individual doc pages are also served as .md files (feature-status.md, ingesting-data.md, drivers-and-clients.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full page coverage) and independent user corroboration of agents consuming it.
